data.one_liner: A common platform interface for the flutter_local_notifications plugin.
data.what_it_does: Defines the common platform interface that platform-specific implementations of the flutter_local_notifications plugin must extend.
use_when: Building platform-specific implementations or extensions for flutter_local_notifications
avoid_when: You just want to display local notifications in a regular Flutter app (use flutter_local_notifications instead)
strengths: Provides a standardized interface for multi-platform local notifications support
weaknesses: Not intended for direct use in end-user applications
data.setup_notes: Platform-specific implementations should extend from the FlutterLocalNotificationsPlatform class and set FlutterLocalNotificationsPlatform.instance.
